scope: Primary-source literature audit; not a systematic exhaustive review or experimental replication

sources.implication: Do not claim grounded measurements or unified outputs alone are novel.

supports: TCP consumes final LLM description features
sources.implication: Encoder unfreezing and spectral language+segmentation are already done.

sources.title: Beyond the Visible: Multispectral Vision-Language Learning for Earth Observation
sources.implication: Caption-based native spectral alignment is a baseline, not standalone novelty.

sources.title: A Vision-Language Framework for Multispectral Scene Representation Using Language-Grounded Features
DOFA-CLIP: Multimodal Vision-Language Foundation Models for Earth Observation
sources.limitation: Abstract-level review only; details must be read before implementation reproduction.

sources.title: Co-Training Vision Language Models for Remote Sensing Multi-task Learning
supports: shared model classification VQA caption grounding detection
sources.implication: Broad application menu and shared text interface are established.

sources.title: A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models
sources.implication: Fractional scene composition pretraining exists; distinguish semantic operation composition from texture mixture.

supports: current report combines v1.1 and v1.2
single bandset and random band dropout
nonlinear projection masking loss and RoPE changes

sources.title: SegGPT: Towards Segmenting Everything in Context
sources.implication: Example-based new concept segmentation is not new by itself.

sources.title: Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once
sources.implication: Prompt composition needs a stronger distinctive EO transfer claim.

sources.title: Enabling Training-Free Text-Based Remote Sensing Segmentation
supports: CLIP or generative VLM plus SAM segmentation baselines
sources.implication: Compare against a strong simple composition baseline; do not label workshop as main conference.

recommendation: Conditional bounded feasibility work; current evidence does not establish CVPR readiness.
exclusions: Third-party search snippets were used only for discovery, then replaced by primary URLs.
No claims of experimental replication or exhaustive prior-art coverage.
